bureau: Credit Information Bureau (Bank of Mongolia) and credit bureaus
note: The Law on Credit Information (20 October 2011), article 11.1, in the Bank of Mongolia's English text: a credit reference covers the last six years of a borrower's credit information. The law was amended in May 2025; the amended text wasn't read. No source read states how many days after its due date a missed payment is reported, so the days are the game's reading: the bureau's next monthly update.

sources.title: Bank of Mongolia, Law of Mongolia on Credit Information (English)
sources.said: Credit reference shall cover last 6 years of credit information for a particular borrower
